preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 10.
The length of the string S must be between 2 and 5000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in {'A', 'B'} for c in S)
preconditions.description: The string S must consist only of characters 'A' and 'B'.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or (len(stdout) > 0 and stdout in S)
postconditions.description: The output must be either '-1' or a string that appears exactly twice as a subsequence in S.
If the output is not '-1', it must be a valid subsequence of S that appears exactly twice.
